# fytrr

> AI-powered fitness app that creates personalized workout and meal plans in 60 seconds.

fytrr is a fitness planning platform built by Tobias Lobitz. It uses artificial intelligence to generate individualized workout routines and nutrition plans based on your goals, fitness level, and available equipment. Available as a mobile app (iOS) and web application.

## Key Features

- AI-generated personalized workout plans
- AI-generated personalized meal plans with grocery lists
- Calorie and macro tracking
- Body progress tracking
- Workout logging and scheduling
- Meal replacement suggestions based on preferences

## Free Tools

- [Calorie Calculator (DE)](https://fytrr.com/de/kostenlose-tools/kalorienrechner): Calculate your BMR and daily calorie needs (TDEE)
- [Calorie Calculator (EN)](https://fytrr.com/en/free-tools/calorie-calculator): Calculate your BMR and daily calorie needs (TDEE)
